change: Cache npm dependencies keyed on package-lock.json with an `npm-default` fallback key; `lint` pushes the cache, other jobs pull it.
expected_effect: Fewer repeated package downloads per job; shorter `npm ci` phase. Effect is measured as runner-minutes (proxy) and pipeline duration (measured).
risk: Low. A stale cache cannot change what is installed because npm ci still verifies against the lockfile; a cache miss only falls back to a full download.

change: Skip lint/test/build for documentation-only changes (*.md, docs/, LICENSE) using rules:changes. secret_detection always runs.
expected_effect: Three jobs avoided per docs-only pipeline. Effect is counted (jobs executed) and measured (duration).
risk: Low-medium. Misclassifying a code file as docs would skip tests; the path list is narrow and reviewed in the MR. Code changes run every job.

change: workflow:rules so a commit on a branch with an open MR runs one pipeline instead of two.
expected_effect: Halves pipelines for MR commits. Counted at the project pipeline list; not part of the per-run comparison.

change: Measure energy per run and calculate SCI.
expected_effect: UNKNOWN until runner energy telemetry or a validated model with a documented boundary is available.
risk: Risk of overclaiming. Not applied: no defensible energy input exists for GitLab shared runners.
